items.exampleEn: Please put the candles out before you go to bed.
You can always rely on me.
Working long hours often results in mistakes.
items.exampleZh: 長時間工作常常導致出錯。

items.exampleEn: I ran into my old teacher at the supermarket.
items.exampleZh: 我在超市偶然遇見以前的老師。

items.exampleEn: My brother finally settled down and bought a house in Tainan.
items.exampleZh: 我的兄弟終於安定下來，在台南買了房子。

items.exampleEn: My cat always shows up when I open the fridge.
items.exampleZh: 我一打開冰箱，我的貓就會出現。

items.exampleEn: Please sign in to check your order.

items.sentenceEn: She showed up at my door with some flowers.
items.sentenceZh: 她帶著一些花出現在我家門口。

items.audioEn: Before you start the test, please sign in at the front desk.
items.audioZh: 開始考試前，請先到服務台簽到。
items.questionZh: 考試開始前要先做什麼？
options: Buy a book at the shop

items.sentenceEn: If you run into Mr. Lin, please say hi for me.
items.sentenceZh: 如果你碰到林先生，請幫我跟他問好。

items.sentenceEn: Our team relies on Ken to fix the computers.
items.sentenceZh: 我們團隊都靠 Ken 修電腦。

items.stemEn: Please ____ the fire before we leave the campsite.
items.stemZh: 我們離開露營區前，請把火熄滅。

items.stemEn: We waited for an hour, but Jason never ____.
items.stemZh: 我們等了一個小時，可是 Jason 一直沒出現。

items.passageEn: Last year, Ben moved to Kaohsiung for a new job. When he first arrived, he knew nobody and had to rely on the map on his phone to find his way. On his first day, the computer system was down, so he couldn't sign in. But things soon got better. His team was kind, and he settled down quickly. Now he even helps new workers. "Moving here resulted in many good changes in my life," he says.
items.passageZh: 去年，Ben 為了新工作搬到高雄。他剛到的時候誰也不認識，只能靠手機上的地圖找路。上班第一天，電腦系統出了問題，所以他沒辦法登入。不過情況很快就好轉了。他的團隊很親切，他也很快安頓下來。現在他甚至會幫助新進的同事。「搬來這裡為我的生活帶來很多好的改變。」他說。

questions.questionZh: Ben 上班第一天為什麼沒辦法登入？

items.promptZh: 我忘記密碼，所以沒辦法登入。
referenceEn: I forgot my password, so I couldn't sign in.
I can't sign in because I forgot my password.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 sign in 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 log in 等）也算對
時態配合句意（例如 couldn't sign in、can't sign in 等）
「忘記密碼」可寫，例如 forgot my password 等

items.promptZh: 這條規定引起了很多抱怨。
referenceEn: This rule resulted in many complaints.
This rule has resulted in many complaints.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達，例如 resulted in 等；不用片語但意思正確的說法（例如 caused、led to 等）也算對
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 resulted in、has resulted in 等）
「很多抱怨」可寫，例如 many complaints、a lot of complaints 等
